questions.prompt: Emphasise the period before the November test: By the time she took that test, she ___ the old routine for months.
questions.explanation: 过去完成时had followed突出早于过去测试的持续经历；will为将来，has following和had follow形式错误。
questions.evidence: Emphasise the period before the November test: By the time she took that test, she had followed the old routine for months.

options: I have seen that movie last week.
I saw that movie last week.
I have saw that movie last week.
I seen that movie last week.
answers: I saw that movie last week.
questions.explanation: last week是明确的过去时间，应该用一般过去时saw，不能用现在完成时。
questions.evidence: I saw that movie last week.

questions.prompt: The count is exactly forty, and has been checked. Which statement preserves that count?
options: The log contains more than forty entries.
The log contains fewer than forty entries.
The log contains at least fifty entries.
questions.explanation: exactly forty明确等于四十；more than为大于，fewer than为小于，at least fifty至少五十，都与已核实数量不符。
questions.evidence: The count is exactly forty, and has been checked. Which statement preserves that count?

questions.prompt: Introduce the specific errors she repeatedly makes: She reviews the errors ___ recur in her speech.
questions.explanation: 先行词errors是物，that在定语从句中作recur主语；what不能直接接既有先行词，whose后需所属名词，whom用于人且作宾语。
questions.evidence: Introduce the specific errors she repeatedly makes: She reviews the errors that recur in her speech.

questions.prompt: Report a limited possibility rather than guaranteeing an exam result: This change ___ improve her performance, but the next test is still needed.
questions.explanation: may准确保留待验证的可能；will certainly和must always过度保证，cannot possibly则排除可能，都不符合limited possibility。
questions.evidence: Report a limited possibility rather than guaranteeing an exam result: This change may improve her performance, but the next test is still needed.

title: The Year-End Review: Rethinking a Learning Plan · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
复盘要把时间、数量和证据范围写准确。had +过去分词突出早于另一过去事件的经历；明确过去时间用一般过去时。more than是严格大于，no more than为不超过，exactly表示恰好，不能互换。情态与限定语防止把个人改善扩大为保证结果。定语从句可指出要纠正的具体错误，基础的第三人称-s、不可数名词和动名词仍可作为个别薄弱点巩固。

She could now point to specific changes in her speaking, not just to hours spent studying.
